g.text: UC-04 Request substitute (FR-06, FR-07, FR-08, FR-22, BR-01, BR-03, BR-13)
open "Request substitute" for own future shift
candidate pool (no availability lookup - retired in iteration 6)
("no co-worker can take it - contact the owner")
show "no eligible worker - contact the owner"
shared mode (iteration 8): the form calls ctx.run(command), so shared.js runs createSubRequest on the
working copy and sends the changed rows (SubRequest, SubRequestTarget, Notification) with the base
revision to RPC app_commit; the row triggers accept only a new request in status REQUESTED whose
deadline and shift start are still in the future by server time (BR-03, BR-12).
